adds.title: General Inspector of Justice of Paraná - Ruling of 26 March 2013
adds.summary: On 26 March 2013 Paraná authorized same-sex civil marriage in all cartórios statewide under the same procedure and documentation as heterosexual marriage and allowed conversion of stable union into marriage without judicial authorization.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court (STF) challenges to Londrina law - Cármen Lúcia injunction and Cristiano Zanin vote
adds.summary: In Londrina, Paraná, a municipal law prohibiting transgender athletes from participating in sports competitions was suspended by STF injunction and Minister Cristiano Zanin voted to declare the ban unconstitutional.

adds.title: Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship resolution on school restrooms + Curitiba City Council protest motion of 4 Oct 2023
adds.summary: On 19 September 2023 Resolution 2/2023 of the Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship provided in article 5 that educational institutions must guarantee use of bathrooms, changing rooms and other gender-segregated spaces according to each student's gender identity and expression while recommending additional individual-use bathrooms in public spaces, but the Ministry clarified it has no binding effect and no school is obliged to adopt it, and on 4 October 2023 the Curitiba City Council approved in symbolic vote a protest motion against the resolution to be converted into an official letter to the federal government.

adds.title: Curitiba unisex bathroom bans - Mara Lima (PSC) state bill 2021 and Ezequias Barros (PMB) municipal bill approved 16 Nov 2021
adds.summary: In 2021 Mara Lima (PSC) presented a Parana state bill prohibiting unisex bathrooms and requiring separate male and female bathrooms, and on 16 Nov 2021 Curitiba approved Ezequias Barros (PMB)'s municipal bill prohibiting unisex bathrooms, limiting access to sex-separated facilities relevant to trans visitors.
